classes.purpose: Static config/registry class describing a game Level (a hub/expedition map instance) in Monster Hunter Online. It is managed by the global CInfoManager<CMHLevelInfo> singleton and aggregates the quests, spawn groups, item drops, hub-entry configs and league schedule attached to a level. Almost every method here is an accessor/iterator over that manager keyed by level id, or a collector that walks the level's sub-lists and validates their referenced Info records (CHubEntry*, CSpawnMonsterGroupInfo, CItemBaseInfo, CLeague*).

methods.purpose: Static singleton accessor: lazily registers the CInfoManager for class "CMHLevelInfo" (StcMbrNameSvr<CInfoManager>) and returns its pointer (DAT_123bec7c). The genuine GetManagers; all other methods in this bundle are mislabeled with the same name.

On the active player/entity (global DAT_1202e818) resolves the current CHubEntryInfo id, walks managers to find the owning CMHLevelInfo then its CMHMapInfo (reading map-name at map+0x2c and resource at +0x5c), builds two fixed strings (16- and 32-byte) and dispatches UI/game event 0x45 via the event system (FUN_10d17870).

Given a hub-entry id, validates it against CHubEntryConfigKingQuestInfo, parses the source list (FUN_1175f3a0; 0x4c-byte source entries), and for each entry whose CMHLevelInfo exists and passes availability checks (FUN_1130d400 unlock, FUN_1130b720 available) appends a 0x80-byte record to the output vector. Reads per-entry fields: +8 id, +0xc, +0x10 (byte), +0x18 (string), +0x30 (string).
Same shape as CollectHubKingQuests but keyed on CHubEntryConfigLetterQuestInfo; source entry stride 0x2c, output 0x80-byte records. Collects available letter/mail quests for the hub entry.

Collector keyed on CHubEntryConfigInfo; source entry stride 0x60. Reads fields +0xc(id), +0x10, +0x20, +0x24, +0x2c, +0x5c(string), copies an inner id sub-vector (+0x14/+0x18 range) and appends 0x80-byte output records for entries that pass FUN_1130b720 availability.
Collector keyed on CHubEntryRaidConfigInfo. Iterates a source list (0x44-byte / 0x11-int stride) via FUN_1175da10, validates each CMHLevelInfo and appends available raid configs to the output vector.

Computes key = pageId*100 + starLevel, looks it up in CHubPageStarLevelInfo, iterates its 8-byte pair list (+0x18/+0x1c), and for each valid CMHLevelInfo appends a 0x80-byte output record. Formula: hubPageStar key = page*100 + star.

Iterates a 0x20-byte-stride array (this+0x10..+0x14), resolves each element's CMHLevelInfo and returns false (0) as soon as it finds a record whose field +0x14 == param_2 with the entry's flag(+4) set; returns true if none match. A predicate over the level's sub-entries. (Exact semantic uncertain.)

Iterates a 0xc-byte-stride array (this+0xc..+0x10), applies predicate FUN_11576ac0, resolves CMHLevelInfo and compares param_3 against (entry+4 + record.subrecord[+0x24][+0x50]). Returns a bool threshold result. (Semantic uncertain.)

Recursive depth-first search over a red-black-tree of level nodes (sentinel local_24) tracking a visited set (this+4/+8); resolves CMHLevelInfo per node and recurses, returning true when a target path is found. Level dependency/reachability search. (Semantic uncertain.)
Iterates every CMHLevelInfo record (count via manager vtable+0x28) performing only the manager-registration boilerplate per record; a no-op-ish enumerate/refresh pass over all levels.

Resolves this level's CMHLevelInfo (id via vtable+0x18), then walks a list-of-lists of spawn entries (this[6]) and validates each entry's CSpawnMonsterGroupInfo id (entry[3]) exists in that manager. Returns bool = all spawn-group references valid.
Iterates a 0x54-byte-stride array (this+0x1c..+0x20) calling FUN_1173b780(param, this+0x10, this+0x18) per element after verifying CMHLevelInfo manager exists. Applies a per-spawn-entry operation.

Reads a global level context (FUN_1171c3f0) fields +0x40/+0x44/+0x48/+0x4c as level ids, checks each resolves in the CMHLevelInfo manager, then returns FUN_107d7930(context+0x50) != 0. Validates the current 4-level chain.

Iterates every CMHLevelInfo record and calls CLevelResInfo::GetManagers_116b2a30(param) for each valid one, then CMHLevelInfo::TouchAllLevels (116b4620). Preloads/binds level resource info for all levels.

Walks the level's list-of-lists of item-drop entries (this+0x14), validates each item id against CItemBaseInfo and its drop-weight float (entry+0xc) against the range [DAT_11de9890, DAT_11de9918], and unlinks/frees entries that are invalid or out of range. Cleans up drop tables.
Iterates every CMHLevelInfo record and appends those whose field[8] equals *(param_1+0x10) into the caller's output vector (param_1+0x128). Groups levels by a shared key field.
Iterates a 0x10-byte-stride array (this+0x18..+0x1c) touching the CItemBaseInfo manager per element; validates/binds the level's item references.
Iterates a 4-byte-stride id array (this+0x14..+0x18) touching the CMHLevelInfo manager per id; validates a list of referenced level ids.
Duplicate/inlined static accessor returning the CInfoManager<CMHLevelInfo> pointer (same as 107d6dd0).
Duplicate/inlined static accessor returning the CInfoManager<CMHLevelInfo> pointer.
Side-effecting accessor: forces creation of the CGuildMatchInfo (FUN_109445a0) and CQualifierMatchInfo managers, then returns the CMHLevelInfo manager pointer.

Resolves a CLeagueSchedule record by id (param_1[5]); for each level id in vector param_1[0x2c]/[0x2d] resolves CMHLevelInfo and writes level+0x264 = schedule+0x14 (league schedule id). Then resolves CLeagueDetail, populates a 0xf8-byte-stride vector (param_1[0x30]/[0x31]) via FUN_11a69550 and sorts it with comparator FUN_11a6bd30. Binds league schedule/detail data onto levels.

classes.notes: Every method carries the mislabeled name CMHLevelInfo::GetManagers because Ghidra propagated the singleton-accessor string. Only 107d6dd0 is truly GetManagers; 11a08370/11a4aaa0 are inlined duplicates. The rest are distinct member functions renamed above by behavior. The pervasive FUN_11679e10(&x,"ClassName",0) + (id-baseId)/bucketSize indexing is the CInfoManager registry lookup (GetById). The Tlv* Task/Level structures are runtime network/save state, NOT this static config class; treat relatedTlv as directional only.

classes.purpose: Static config/registry class describing a Task (quest / objective definition) in MHO, managed by the global CInfoManager<CTaskInfo> singleton. It is loaded from task-library config blobs and, at runtime, is queried to build task sets, active-task chains, and NPC/location task lists, and to validate task-condition references (tutorial counters, buffs, other tasks). Sibling config types referenced: CTaskLibInfo, CTutorialCounterInfo, CBuffInfo.

methods.purpose: Static singleton accessor: lazily registers the CInfoManager for class "CTaskInfo" and returns its pointer (DAT_123be16c). The genuine GetManagers; the rest of the bundle is mislabeled with this name.

Looks up a CTaskLibInfo by id (param_3), and for each task id in the input vector (param_4) resolves the CTaskInfo record and registers it via FUN_114e4860, then notifies via (this+0x78 vtable)+0x3c(id). Loads all tasks belonging to a task library.

Builds a task-set object from an id list (param_2): initializes (FUN_111eee60/FUN_10a14650), inserts each resolved CTaskInfo into a tree at this+0x14 (FUN_111ef110 key=id,val=record), then stores this+0xc0=param_3, +0xc8=param_4, +0xc4=0, +0xcc=param_5.

Loads a fixed-capacity (128-entry) task table from config param_2: parallel arrays ids=param_2[2..], values=param_2[0x82..], count=param_2[1]; for each resolved CTaskInfo calls FUN_1152d430(record,value). Then a second list param_2[0x102] via FUN_1152d3f0. Fires game event 700 (0x2bc).

Variant loader: clears this[0x14]/[0x15] vector, parallel arrays ids=param_2[2..] values=param_2[7..] count=param_2[1], per record FUN_11530d30; second list param_2[0xc] via FUN_11530cf0. Fires event 0x27b (635).

Lazily builds/caches the active-task chain vector at this+0xf0/+0xf4/+0xf8. Seeds from a system manager (FUN_117f86d0+0x48), bounded by main-task count (117c1580); walks resolving each CTaskInfo, filtering with FUN_117c19b0, appending record pointers, following next-id = record[0xb]+0x134 until count reached.

Deserializes a task set from a large config blob (param_2): reads int16 count at +0x158c (capped 64), int16 task-id array at +0x158e, inserts each resolved CTaskInfo into tree this+0x90 (FUN_111ef110); then stores this+0xc0=blob+0x160e, +0xc4=0, +0xc8=blob+0x1612, +0xcc=blob+0x1616.

Primary deserializer copying a serialized task struct (param_2) into this: id +0x10=src[0], +0x48=src+0x12, +0x4c=0, byte flag +0x60=src+0x16, +0x64=src+0x17, +0x74=src+0x1b, +0x78=src+0x1f, +0xbc=src+0x20b. Initializes a 60-slot condition bitset (FUN_115bed10 0,0x3c; FUN_115bee10 src+2,src[1]), builds condition tree at this+0x14 over 60 slots, loads child-task-id entries (count src+0x23) into tree, and appends ids (count src+0x77) to vector this+0xb0. Best field-layout source.

Another config loader: clears this+0x50 vector, inits (FUN_111eee60/FUN_10462c40), reads this+0x5c=param_2[0], this+0x78=param_2[0x11c], this+0x7c=bool(param_2[0x11d]); parallel-array loop (ids param_2[2..], values param_2[7..], count param_2[1]) building trees (this+0x50, FUN_11532d80); then lists param_2[0xc] and param_2[0x21].

Iterates all CTaskInfo records; for each task object (record+0x2c), if obj[0xc]==param_1 appends to vector (param_1 target)+0x11c (accept-NPC list) and if obj[0xd]==param_1 appends to +0x128 (submit-NPC list). Collects tasks whose start/end NPC matches.
Iterates all CTaskInfo records and appends those whose obj[0xb]+0xe0 equals *(param_1+0x10) into vector param_1+0x34. Collects tasks matching a key field.
Counts CTaskInfo records whose task-definition (record+0x2c)+0x10 == 1 (main/primary task type) and caches the count in DAT_12392bc8; returns it. Also copies name strings during the scan variant.

Post-load init over all tasks: copies name (obj[0xb]+0x4c, 0x1f) and a second string (0x1e); for main tasks (obj[0xb]+0x10==1) increments DAT_12392bc8, scans objectives list (obj[0xb]+0x20) for a type==6 objective (vtable+0x10) and stores its target id into obj[0xb]+0x134; finalizes each task (vtable+0x18) unless obj[0xe] and predicate FUN_11747260 hold.
Iterates all CTaskInfo records calling FUN_117c2120 per record (a per-task refresh/apply pass).
Iterates all CTaskInfo records calling FUN_117c1a00(param) per record, then runs PostLoadInitAllTasks (117c2cd0).

Iterates all CTaskInfo records; for those whose obj[0x2c]+0x18 == *(this+0x10) scores via FUN_119d88e0, tracking the highest-scoring task, then appends that task's produced id list to vector this+0x34.

Validates a task condition/requirement descriptor (param_1): switches on type param_1[0] and checks the referenced entity exists — 0x12d/0x12f -> CTutorialCounterInfo, 0x2bd-0x2c2 -> CTaskInfo, 0x385 -> CBuffInfo (with slot param_1[2] in 0..7), 0x4b1 -> ref id in 1..0x198. Returns bool valid.

classes.notes: All 17 methods are mislabeled CTaskInfo::GetManagers (symbol propagation). Only 104d8c80 is the real singleton accessor. TlvTaskContent (id, lib, arg1-3, npc, name, note) is the network/serialized view and aligns loosely with the config CTaskInfo loaded here (id, lib id, npc, name), but CTaskInfo is the client static-config class, not the TLV reader — relatedTlv is directional. The record layout uses a two-level indirection: manager -> record(+0x2c = task object) -> obj[0xb] = task-definition struct where the descriptive fields live; offsets marked obj[...] are relative to that def struct and are inferred, not from a DebugFormat printer (none present in this bundle).
